entities.summary: Lomba da Fazenda is a parish in the municipality of Nordeste in the Azores. The population in 2011 was 844, in an area of 14.77 km2. It contains the localities Lomba da Cruz, Conceição, Arraiado, Barreiros e Canada Francisco Duarte, Leira, R. Dr. Man. João da Silveira e Canada do Cristiano, Vale, Outeiro, Almas and Termo.
